site.hero_sub: Everything your team, band, and fans need for gameday at Homewood High School — home of the Patriots.
site.address_note: note: this is not the HHS campus

stops.what: Gates open — 90 minutes before kickoff. Parking is included with your game ticket.
Pre-game warmups conclude and the field is cleared. Homecoming and special events may alter the agenda — you'll be notified in advance.
Kickoff under the lights at Waldrop Stadium.

welcome.kicker: A Note From Our Athletic Director
welcome.heading: Dear Principal / Coach,
welcome.p1: On behalf of our principal, Dr. Joel Henneke, welcome to Waldrop Stadium, home of Patriots Football. This guide covers everything you'll need for the upcoming contest — gameday contacts, parking, directions, and ticket information.
welcome.p2: If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact me or Dr. Henneke at the school at (205) 871-9663, or on our cell phones listed below. We're both happy to help with any questions or concerns regarding Homewood athletic contests. We look forward to your visit to Homewood!
welcome.quote: We look forward to your visit to Homewood and our game at Waldrop Stadium!
welcome.sig_title: System Athletic Director, Homewood City Schools

parking.lede: All buses enter the main gate on Snow Drive, where staff will direct you to your parking area. Parking is included in the purchase of a game ticket.

cards.title: Team Arrival
items: Enter the main gate on Snow Drive — you'll be directed where to park the buses
The visitor locker room is on the north side of the parking lot
An administrator will meet you at the visitor gate for entry
Only coaches and players in uniform will be allowed to enter

cards.title: Band Arrival
items: Enter the main gate on Snow Drive — you'll be directed where to park the buses
The band should enter through the visitor gate
Only band members and their workers will be allowed to enter

cards.title: Visitor Parking
items: Parking is available on site
Visitors may park in the main lot, the overflow stadium lots, and the West Homewood Athletic Complex (see diagram)
Recommended: enter at West Homewood Park and drive around to the 6 Acres parking lot — it's the closest lot to the visitor entrance
Parking is included with your game ticket

parking.caption: Gameday parking — aerial view of Waldrop Stadium with labeled parking areas, entrances, and the West Homewood Athletic Complex overflow lots.

policies.title: Pass Gate
items: AHSAA passes accepted — cardholders must be present and may bring one guest per pass
Team managers, film crew, and athletic trainers must accompany the team on arrival or show proper ID at the main pass gate

policies.title: Press Box
items: Visitor coaches use the stairs at the 40-yard line; only uniformed members may enter
Power will be made available
Need extra media space? Notify our Athletic Director 2 weeks before the event

policies.title: Sideline & Track
items: No vehicles on the track
Tents and electronic devices are allowed on the track — power should be working, but come prepared to meet your own needs just in case
Lifts or other end-zone/track equipment require Athletic Director approval 2 weeks prior

policies.title: Trainers & Medical
items: Two certified athletic trainers and one team physician on the sideline each game
AED located at the visitor's concession stand
Homewood Police & Fire on hand at every home varsity game
Regional Paramedic Service (RPS) on site for any medical transport needs

policies.title: Prohibited Items
items: Outside food and drink
Personal heaters
Alcohol, tobacco, and electronic cigarettes
Firearms or weapons of any kind

policies.title: Weather
items: Our Head Athletic Trainer and administration will notify you of severe weather in the area
Appropriate announcements will be made in the stadium if needed
Advance tickets available online through GoFan
Gates open 90 minutes before kickoff
Parking is included with your game ticket
Region games: 25 complimentary tickets provided through GoFan, emailed to your Athletic Director

directions.lede: 266 Snow Drive, Homewood, AL 35209 — please note the stadium is at a different location from the Homewood High School campus.

routes.title: From I-65 North
steps: Follow I-65 S to Lakeshore Pkwy, Exit 255
Bear RIGHT onto Lakeshore Drive and continue about 1.5 miles
Turn RIGHT onto West Oxmoor Road and travel about 0.5 miles
Turn RIGHT onto Snow Drive — the stadium is 0.3 miles ahead on your LEFT

routes.title: From I-65 South
steps: Follow I-65 N to Lakeshore Pkwy, Exit 255
Turn LEFT onto Lakeshore Drive and continue about 1.6 miles
Turn RIGHT onto West Oxmoor Road and travel about 0.5 miles
Turn RIGHT onto Snow Drive — the stadium is 0.3 miles ahead on your LEFT

school.heading: Visit Homewood Athletics
school.blurb: Schedules, rosters, tickets, news, and info for every Homewood sport — all in one place.

media.heading: Media & Broadcast Information
media.lede: Information for visiting broadcasts, press, and photographers. Every Homewood home game is streamed live — even if you're not sending your own crew, your fans back home can still watch.

cards.title: Press & Media
items: Media check-in is at the main pass gate — credentials or school ID required
Limited press box space is available; notify our Athletic Director 2 weeks in advance
Power and Wi-Fi access can be arranged on request

cards.title: Visiting Broadcasts
items: Visiting radio/broadcast crews are welcome — contact us ahead of time so we can reserve space
A broadcast location with power is available in the press box
Let us know your equipment needs when you reach out
